name: 分诊台
author: jjjjjjjjnnjnn
description: 装前判断与装后归因：一条命令说明插件为什么从你的组合里消失。默认只读——不安装到你的 profile、不卸载、不判安全；只有显式 `--apply` 才改配置，先备份、可 `--undo` 逐字节还原。
descriptionEn: Pre-install judgement and post-install attribution: one command explains why a plugin disappeared from your composition. Read-only by default — it never installs into your profile, never removes, and never claims a plugin is safe; only an explicit `--apply` changes config, after a backup, and `--undo` restores the bytes.
